name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The '0a' is the dispatch-table index (per-event handler table at 0x51B91; verified entry at 0x51BB9 = 0x00034E3B), a legitimate domain ID consistent with the whole sibling group. 'ch14' is chapter 14 (valid chapter ID 01-30). 'first_time' is the category. No Ghidra address residue; name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Chapter-14 first-time-gated tile-step event handler (dispatch idx 0x0A): on first trigger, disarm the per-event AI/dialog control flag for chars 0x10..0x47, show dialog page 1, then consume the trigger.
logic_summary: Reads tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] via data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr. If still 0 (not yet consumed): (1) call fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(0x10,0x47,0) -- writes low nibble of each runtime char's combat_aux_block[0xD] = 0 for the inclusive range 0x10..0x47 (56 chars), disarming the AI/dialog control flag; (2) fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=1, fixed geometry); (3) set tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] = 1 to consume so later calls are no-ops. Single branch, no RNG, no numeric computation, dialog return discarded.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform 1-arg cdecl argument passed by the per-event dispatch table at 0x51B91; this handler never reads it (body is (void)event_arg).
params.reason: Name correctly reflects the dispatch-table ABI argument; arg is intentionally unread. No address residue.
